title: Another customer's data is disclosed
description: The assistant shows one customer's order, email, phone, name or address to someone else, e.g. a person who guesses an order ID or claims to be a family member.
existing_control: Order details only after the order ID and the email on that order match (agent.verify, ShopData.verify); the check node removes any other customer's order before the reply; order_view() never includes name, email or phone; guards.find_leaks() replaces any reply that contains another customer's data, now compared in normalised form (DR-1 fix: digits, phone prefixes, spacing, case, disguised emails); handover after 3 failed checks.
test_evidence: P1 deterministic tests passed 2026-10-08 (E01, E02, E09, E12), including 25 leak-filter spellings added by the DR-1 fix (E39). Rules baseline: 0/120 conversations with leaked_other_customer_data (E13). Live agent eval on openai/gpt-6-luna, 2026-10-08 (P1 agent_cheap_2026-10-08): 0/120 conversations with a violation (E14); other_person_order 15/15 (E15). P3 leak rules tested (E20). P8 probe of the leak filter: 3 of 6 variants on the 15:51 snapshot, 6 of 6 after the fix (E35). P3 red-team on bare models, run 20261008T124509Z (judge verdicts, not human): pii_extraction 9/9 blocked for openai/gpt-6-luna, no customer phone or email in any answer (E23).
next_action: Verified on a small scripted set (15 other-person conversations, 9 P3 attacks, 25 leak spellings), one run each: keep adding new attacks and re-run E14/E15 on every model or prompt change; mask contact details before model calls (R14).

title: Prompt injection makes the assistant act against the rules
description: Text in a customer message, a pasted review or a policy/FAQ snippet tells the model to skip approval, reveal data or change its role, and the system follows it.
existing_control: Customer and retrieved text are wrapped in data tags with angle brackets neutralised (parsing.as_prompt_data); both prompts say tagged text is data; the model never chooses tools (plain code in agent.act does); money and data changes can only be queued for a human; injection keywords add a security note to the CRM.
test_evidence: P1 tests passed 2026-10-08, including a fake model that obeys the attack: refund still pending for a supervisor, nothing paid (E03, E04). Rules baseline: 0/15 injection conversations caused a violation, but only 3/15 reached the expected outcome (E13). Live agent eval on openai/gpt-6-luna, 2026-10-08 (P1 agent_cheap_2026-10-08): prompt_injection 15/15 and other_person_order 15/15 task success, 0/120 violations (E14, E15). P3 red-team on bare models, run 20261008T124509Z (judge verdicts, not human): prompt_injection 9/9 and jailbreak_roleplay 9/9 blocked for openai/gpt-6-luna; no canary or staff-code leak (E22, E26). anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5 missed 1 of 9 injections (a likely rule false positive, open hand check).
next_action: Verified only against known, scripted attacks (15 P1 conversations, 18 P3 attacks, one run): an external red-team with new and adaptive attacks before real customers; add every new attack to P1's conversations; re-run on every model or prompt change.

title: Wrong or unauthorised refund
description: A refund is promised or paid that the policy does not allow (opened product, outside 14 days, wrong amount, someone else's order).
existing_control: request_refund only queues an approval; return eligibility is computed in code (data.return_eligibility); amount must be between 0 and the order total and the order must belong to the verified customer; refunds above AED 200 need a supervisor (crm.approval_level); a denied item has no effect; the reply prompt forbids saying a refund is done unless approved.
test_evidence: P1 tests passed 2026-10-08 (E05, E11). Rules baseline: 0/120 conversations with action_decided_without_human or refund_over_200_not_escalated (E13). Live agent eval on openai/gpt-6-luna, 2026-10-08 (P1 agent_cheap_2026-10-08): 0/120 violations (E14) and 45/45 correct approval decisions in return_refund, address_change and prompt_injection (E37). The all-120 decision figure (117/120, E16) moved to R15 because its 3 misses are handovers, not refunds.
next_action: Re-run E37 when a model, prompt or approval rule changes; finance reviews a weekly sample of approved refunds after launch.

title: A retry pays or changes something twice
description: A network retry, a double click or a LangGraph resume repeats an approved refund or address change.
existing_control: The same pending request is never queued twice; CrmStore.decide() does nothing for an already decided item; no side effects before interrupt() in wait_for_approval.
next_action: Re-test when the JSON-file CRM is replaced by a database or a real refund API.

title: Unauthorised delivery-address change
description: Someone redirects another person's parcel by asking the assistant to change the address.
existing_control: Address change needs a verified customer, only works while the order is 'processing', and is only applied after a person approves it (CrmStore.update_address, decide).
test_evidence: P1 tests passed 2026-10-08 (E07, E01). Live agent eval on openai/gpt-6-luna, 2026-10-08 (P1 agent_cheap_2026-10-08): address_change 15/15 and 45/45 correct approval decisions (E37). The all-120 decision figure (E16) moved to R15.
next_action: Approvers call or email the customer when the new address is in a different city; re-run E37 after any change.

title: Hallucinated or wrong policy answer
description: The assistant states a return window, delivery time, COD limit or refund rule that is not the shop's policy.
existing_control: Replies use only the facts and policy sections the code retrieved (prompt rule 1); decisions such as return eligibility are made by code, not the model; if the model fails, a fixed template is used.
test_evidence: P1 return-policy rules tested (E11). P3 grounding check: 0 validation problems in 225 items (E21). P3 policy_fact on bare models, judge-scored: openai/gpt-6-luna 52/54 (en-pol-004 and fr-pol-003 failed for saying delivery is free, which is the shop policy: likely judge errors, not yet confirmed by a person) (E27, failed on the strict reading).
next_action: Sara checks the 2 failed GPT-6 Luna answers and the judge (E29); give the judge the full policy text; add any confirmed wrong policy answer to P1's eval set.

title: Worse quality or impolite tone in one language
description: Arabic (especially dialect or Arabizi) or French customers get less accurate, less natural or less polite answers than English customers.
existing_control: Language detected by code and reply forced to that language; every metric is reported per language; native-speaker review of the Arabic and French texts is planned (Sara).
test_evidence: P1 live agent eval per language: task success ar 39/40, en 39/40, fr 39/40; LLM-judge tone ar 4.83, en 4.55, fr 4.60 (E17; judge google/gemini-3.8-flash, not a human). P3 per-language quality on bare models, judge-scored: openai/gpt-6-luna tone 4.97 / 4.92 / 4.95 and language 5.00 in ar / en / fr; Gulf Arabic 14/15 passed (E28). Judge-vs-human agreement: not run yet (E19, E29). P3 native-speaker review done: 0/150 items so far (E21 notes).
next_action: Sara reviews the Arabic and French templates and test items before the live run.

title: Unsafe skincare or medical advice
description: The assistant suggests a product for a medical condition, pregnancy or a prescription treatment, or says something is safe when it may not be.
existing_control: Prompt rule 5 (general advice only; refer to a dermatologist or doctor); advice template says 'not medical advice, patch-test first'; product suggestions come only from the catalogue search in code.
test_evidence: P3 red-team on bare models, run 20261008T124509Z (judge verdicts, not human): unsafe_advice 9/9 blocked and 0 harmful for all three models (E24). The full P1 agent has not been tested on medical-advice attacks yet (E41, not run yet); no P1 test checks the medical-referral wording.
next_action: Add P1 conversations about pregnancy, eczema and prescription creams in all three languages.

title: Invented discount, code or promise
description: The assistant agrees to a fake discount code, free product or exception because a customer insists or claims special status.
existing_control: No discount tool exists; prompt rule 1 forbids inventing discounts or promises; P3 checks answers for forbidden strings such as invented codes.
test_evidence: P3 leak and forbidden-string rules tested (E20). P3 red-team on bare models, run 20261008T124509Z (judge verdicts, not human): discount_fraud 9/9 blocked for all three models, no invented code (E25). The full P1 agent has not been tested on discount attacks yet (E41, not run yet).
next_action: Add the P3 discount attacks to P1's eval set so the full agent is tested too.

title: Missing or unclear AI disclosure
description: A customer does not realise they are talking to an AI (EU AI Act Article 50(1) from 2 August 2026; DIFC Regulation 10 notice).
existing_control: The first reply always starts with a fixed disclosure in the customer's language, added by code (guards.disclosure); the demo page banner says it is an AI assistant in Arabic, English and French (DR-3 fix); the eval flags missing_ai_disclosure.
test_evidence: test_first_reply_discloses_ai_assistant passed 2026-10-08 for ar, en and fr, plus the three-language banner test (E08). Rules baseline: 0/120 missing_ai_disclosure (E13). P8 probe: Arabic and English agent replies start with the disclosure even when the model is down (E36). Live agent eval on openai/gpt-6-luna, 2026-10-08 (P1 agent_cheap_2026-10-08): 0/120 violations, so 0/120 missing_ai_disclosure (E14); the same model without the code guard missed it in 120/120 (plain baseline, E14 notes).
next_action: Article 50(1) evidence is in place. Still open: a reminder when a chat becomes a complaint, an accessibility check, and vendor answers on Article 50(2) marking (see EU memo 5.2).

title: Model or service outage
description: OpenRouter, the model or the courier API is down or slow, so customers get errors or long waits.
existing_control: If the reply model fails, a fixed template answer is used; if the intent model fails, keyword rules are used; the courier client retries; failed calls are logged; customers can always ask for a person.
test_evidence: Courier retry tested (E10). Model outage: P8 probe 2/2 (E36) and committed P1 tests 3/3 (E38). Live agent eval on openai/gpt-6-luna, 2026-10-08 (P1 agent_cheap_2026-10-08): 0 errors and 0 failed model calls in 120 conversations; avg 4,390 ms per conversation (E18). Switch-off procedure documented but not rehearsed (E32).
next_action: Rehearse the switch-off levels once (tabletop); add the ASSISTANT_ENABLED flag; set an alert on error rate and latency.

title: Cost overrun
description: Token use grows (long chats, loops, an expensive model) and the monthly bill passes the budget.
existing_control: Cheap model for intent; max_tokens caps; demo limit of 20 messages per session; cost from OpenRouter logged per call in traces.jsonl; evaluation budget guard (MAX_COST_PER_RUN_USD).
test_evidence: P3 budget guard tests passed (E30). P1 live agent eval: avg US$0.000233 per conversation on openai/gpt-6-luna; US$0.005003 with anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5 replies on 30 conversations (E18). P3: answer cost per 100 answers US$0.0092 for openai/gpt-6-luna; the LLM judge costs about 30 times more per answer (US$0.2727 per 100) (E31).
next_action: Set a monthly budget alert on the OpenRouter key; review cost per conversation weekly; re-check if replies move to anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5 (about 21 times the cost per conversation, E18).

title: Sensitive data kept in logs and tickets
description: Customers type health details or other sensitive data, which end up in CRM tickets and notes and are kept too long (UAE PDPL).
existing_control: Model-call traces store only metadata (model, tokens, cost, latency, outcome), not message text; handover tickets keep at most 500 characters of the last message.
test_evidence: Data inventory and retention rules documented (E33, E32). No redaction test exists.
next_action: Redact health terms, emails and phone numbers from ticket summaries; set and enforce retention; add a test.

title: Chat data sent to a model provider abroad
description: Customer messages (which can include their email and address) are processed by a model provider outside the UAE, which is a cross-border transfer under PDPL Articles 22-23.
existing_control: Order facts sent to the model exclude name, email and phone (order_view); only the verified customer's data is ever in the prompt.
test_evidence: Data flows documented in the UAE notes (E33). No technical control yet masks what the customer types.
next_action: Mask emails and phone numbers before model calls; sign data-processing terms; choose providers that do not keep or train on data; counsel confirms the transfer basis.

title: Weak human oversight (approvals and handover)
description: Approvers click 'approve' without checking (automation bias), or anyone acts as 'supervisor', so the AED 200 rule and the audit log lose their value; or a customer who should reach a person (angry, repeated failures) is not handed over.
existing_control: The code refuses a large refund unless the decision is made with the supervisor role, and every decision is logged to approval_log.jsonl. Since the DR-2 fix the reviewer's role and ID come from configuration (APPROVER_ROLE, APPROVER_ID; unknown roles count as 'team'), not from an on-screen choice, but there is no sign-in. Angry customers, low confidence and 3 failed checks hand over to a person.
test_evidence: Supervisor rule tested (E05). DR-2 tests and P8 probe passed: no on-screen role choice, least privilege by default, AED 344 refund refused for the default role (E40). Live agent eval on openai/gpt-6-luna, 2026-10-08 (P1 agent_cheap_2026-10-08): approval and handover decisions 117/120 (E16, failed): the angry_customer-d script was not handed over in any language. Oversight design and approver checklist documented (E32). Code-review finding documented (E34).
next_action: Before real customers: sign-in for the Approvals tab with the role taken from the account and the person's ID in the log; fix and re-test the missed handover (angry_customer-d) without tuning on the test set (add new angry-customer scripts); monthly sample review of decisions.
